title: Research in the C4AI

heroBlocks.html: C4AI focuses its research on two areas: natural language processing for the languages of Brazil, including Portuguese and Indigenous languages, and AI governance, with macro governance (AI and public policy) and micro governance (AI deployment and evaluation).
